ItemID: NA; Title: Partners; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Vocal duets appeal to me given my interest in polished ensemble singing and musical standards.
ItemID: NA; Title: Gary Puckett & The Union Gap: Greatest Hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Older pop has some appeal, but I am more interested in orchestral and theatrical vocals right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Glen Campbell: Greatest Hits; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: His melodic country sound fits the country albums I have enjoyed, so I would try this collection.
ItemID: NA; Title: Emerald: Musical Gems Deluxe; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its Celtic vocal repertoire sounds like a good match for my interest in expressive ensemble performances.
ItemID: NA; Title: 20th Century Masters: The Millennium Collection - The Best of the Andrews Sisters; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Vintage vocal harmonies are appealing, but this is not the style I am seeking this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Singles; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone does not tell me enough about the artist or music to choose it.
ItemID: NA; Title: 25; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am currently more drawn to classical crossover and stage songs than contemporary pop.
ItemID: NA; Title: Standing Ovation: The Greatest Songs from the Stage; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Stage songs strongly match my interest in Stages and A Musical Affair; this would be my first choice.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best of Frankie Valli & The 4 Seasons Single; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Familiar pop harmonies could be enjoyable, but they are less compelling than the stage and ensemble recordings here.
ItemID: NA; Title: 20 All Time Greatest Hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Without an artist or track list, I cannot tell whether this collection fits my preferences.
